Chapter 355: Chapter 13: Spreading Martial Tao, Preemptive Planning (Happy New Year)

Chapter 355: Chapter 13: Spreading Martial Tao, Preemptive Planning (Happy New Year)

Lin Yuan looked down expressionlessly at the numerous powerful figures below bowing respectfully. These people can be said to be the most elite forces of the entire Tianqing World.

Or rather, they are the group that holds the core power of the Tianqing Alliance.

Indeed, within the Tianqing Alliance, the Alliance Leader is the strongest. However, to govern a force, relying solely on the most powerful is futile.

Rather, one must rely on their subordinates. Power is not top-down, but bottom-up.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader is usually either in seclusion, cultivating, or battling with the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Where does he have the time to manage the Tianqing Alliance?

...

Simply put, these are the real controllers of the entire Tianqing Alliance, that is, the real rulers of the Tianqing World.

Lin Yuan controlling these people means controlling the Tianqing World, and this is by no means an exaggeration.

As for the Tianqing Alliance Leader?

His most trusted subordinates, cherished beauty, and valued descendants are now all under Lin Yuan’s control, and they are currently completely unaware of it.

To Lin Yuan, the Tianqing Alliance Leader is merely meat on the chopping board, to be handled whenever he wishes.

“Things are going too smoothly…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the crowd and couldn’t help feeling a bit emotional.

At first, he merely wanted to find a few strong members of the Tianqing Alliance to parasitize and then infiltrate the Tianqing Alliance.

To gradually expand thereafter.

Where could he have imagined that the development would be too rapid, unable to halt the progression, and he accidentally became the puppet master of the Tianqing World.

Lin Yuan began to recap in his mind.

Firstly, things went this smoothly.

because the Tianqing Alliance Leader decided to launch a counterattack against the Foreign Evil God, sending the twelve Alliance leaders and many protector elders into the Tianqing World, which significantly impacted the outcome.

Had these powerful members of the Tianqing Alliance still been in the Evil God Battlefield, Lin Yuan would not have found it easy to make a move.

As to prevent the phenomenon of ‘deserting,’ the Tianqing Alliance Leader had already decreed that any cultivator on the Evil God Battlefield may not return to the Tianqing World without his command.

This would make Lin Yuan’s ‘parasitization’ not so smooth.

because the perfected Demonic Parasitic Ability required Lin Yuan to be present and perform it personally.

If those strong ones did not come over, Lin Yuan could not possibly go to the Evil God Battlefield alone.

However, under the orders of the Tianqing Alliance Leader, all the Vice Alliance Hierarchs and protector elders returned, providing Lin Yuan with an excellent external environment.

Secondly, emotions.

Generally speaking, the more powerful an individual, the lonelier they are, and the fewer friends they have.

With no emotional ties, you won’t believe which place boasts a peerless treasure.

You say there is a treasure, just like that?

However, these Vice Alliance Hierarchs and protectors of the Tianqing Alliance had deep bonds after battling together against the Foreign Evil God on the battlefield for three to four hundred years.

They likely had life-saving bonds.

The trust foundation is very high, and now that they’re back in the Tianqing World, everyone is in a good mood, and their vigilance is lowering. That’s why they could be attracted one by one, allowing Lin Yuan to ‘parasitize’ them sequentially.

Then, it was the ‘parasitic’ ability perfected by Lin Yuan.

This reason is perhaps the most significant one. The Tianqing Alliance was very familiar with the parasitic ability of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

It never occurred to anyone that the parasitized fighters would perfectly replace their original selves, leading no one to think in that direction.

This is also why these powerful figures of the Tianqing World are unable to handle unexpected situations and lack countermeasures.

Lastly.

It is Lin Yuan’s strength that is sufficiently strong.

Even if he lured in the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs and the Four Divine Beast Kings one by one, all of whom are Seventh Rank in terms of combat power,

even if they are far inferior to Lin Yuan, there was a chance they could have sent out a message.

However, under Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Spatial Prison, isolated from everything, none of these Vice Alliance Hierarchs nor the Holy Beast Kings managed to send out a message after being successfully parasitized.

The most important aspect is that those who were parasitized did not die but lived in another form, meaning it was impossible to detect anything unusual through means like Life Fire.

because they hadn’t died, any predictions of life or death through Life Fire and other means naturally became useless.

…

“Master, this is all I know…”

A breathtakingly beautiful woman respectfully said; this woman was the mistress of the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

With her statement, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Tianqing Alliance Leader had reached an unprecedented level.

He even knew what color underwear the other person wore.

“Master, should we bring the Alliance Leader over now?”

Another Vice Alliance Hierarch respectfully asked, whose contributions were indispensable in Lin Yuan successfully controlling the Tianqing World this time.

Most of the Vice Alliance Hierarchs from the Tianqing Alliance had been led by him.

As the current Tianqing Alliance Leader’s mentor, this Vice Alliance Hierarch held tremendous prestige within the Tianqing Alliance.

With him stepping forward, which other Vice Alliance Hierarch would dare to refuse?

The reason he could lead this Vice Alliance Hierarch over was entirely because Lin Yuan controlled the sizable protector position held by this Vice Alliance Hierarch’s favored descendent.

This Vice Alliance Hierarch adored this descendent tremendously, allowing Lin Yuan to successfully clinch him.

“Not for now.”

Lin Yuan shook his head as he was not planning to make a move against the Tianqing Alliance Leader immediately.

His greatest advantage now lies in the shadows; the Tianqing Alliance Leader had no idea that everything he had painstakingly managed had already fallen into Lin Yuan’s hands.

Therefore,

the timing of Lin Yuan’s move against the Tianqing Alliance Leader is crucial.

If he were to bring the Tianqing Alliance Leader over now, it might raise suspicions.

After all, with the Foreign Evil God still unresolved and as the strongest of the Tianqing Alliance, the only one capable of combating the Ancestral Demon Tree, why would returning to the Tianqing World be appropriate?
